{"metadata":{"description":"nebula v5 plugin for deepseek harness","id":"gh:1334066448","install_available":true,"language":"Gherkin","name":"dsh-nebulagraph-v5","slug":"xiajingchun/dsh-nebulagraph-v5","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"nebula v5 plugin for deepseek harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-nebula"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects to a
**NebulaGraph v5** server and executes **ISO-GQL** stat"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ements, in the spirit of
the `ngql` console."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The plugin speaks the native NebulaGraph v5 wire protocol (gRPC +
`nebula.proto.graph.GraphService`)"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" with a **pure-JS client** — no native
modules, no external gateway. Results come back as structured"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" JSON rows plus
an ngql-style ASCII table render."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Connect / authenticate against a graphd (`nebula_connect`), execute GQL on
the same server-side se"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ssion (`nebula_execute`), and close it
(`nebula_disconnect`).
- **Named instance profiles (Settings "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"→ NebulaGraph)**: manage any number of
connection presets in the DSH settings page — each with its o"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"wn
host/port/user/passwordRef/TLS policy — addressed by a short alias. The
model then just says *"co"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"nnect to the `prod` Nebula"* and calls
`nebula_connect(instance: "prod")`; the profile supplies the "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"parameters.
An instance can be marked as the default, used when no alias is given.
Per-call tool arg"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"uments still override the profile.
- Decodes the columnar `VectorResultTable` payload exactly like t"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"he official
nebula-go v5 client: scalars, strings, temporal values, lists, sets, maps,
records, vert"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"ices, edges, paths, embedding vectors, geography, `Any`-typed
columns, const vectors, and null bitma"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"ps.
- **Schema exploration (`nebula_schema`)**: one call runs `SHOW GRAPHS`,
resolves the target gra"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"ph (explicit `graph=` argument, the session working
graph from `SESSION SET graph`, or the sole grap"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"h), then `DESC GRAPH TYPE`
and returns the graph type's node types and edge types — labels,
primary/"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"multiedge keys, and properties. Read-only: the session working graph
is never changed.
- **Interacti"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"ve graph rendering (Web Client)**: when a `nebula_execute` result
contains nodes, edges, or paths, t"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"he result is projected into a replayable
graph payload and the bundled Web Client plugin renders it "},{"id":"p6s16","text":"as an interactive
AntV G6 graph (drag / zoom / hover),
alongside the normal table output.
- Bundles "},{"id":"p6s17","text":"the **`gql-query-generator`** skill: the plugin registers a
`ctx.skills` provider so the agent's `sk"},{"id":"p6s18","text":"ill` tool can load NebulaGraph
GQL-writing guidance (reference docs ship in `gql-query-generator/ref"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"erences/`
and resolve against the packaged directory).
- Plugin config supplies default connection p"},{"id":"p6s20","text":"arameters; every tool argument
can override them per call.
- **Password never travels through the mo"},{"id":"p6s21","text":"del**: `nebula_connect` takes a
`passwordRef` (a credential reference / environment variable name), "},{"id":"p6s22","text":"onnect` takes a
`passwordRef` (a credential reference / environment variable name), not the
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| `nebula_connect` | Connect to a graphd and open a session. Arguments: `instance` (alias of a profi"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"le configured in Settings → NebulaGraph), `host`, `port`, `user`, `passwordRef`, `tls`, `ca`, `timeo"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"utMs` (all optional). Resolution order: explicit `instance` alias → the default instance (if set) → "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"plugin config; per-call arguments override the profile. The password itself is never an argument — i"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"t resolves from `passwordRef` via the DSH credentials seam / environment. Returns a `connectionId` ("},{"id":"p9s6","text":"plus `instance`, `viaDefault`, `warning`, and `tlsFallback` when relevant). |
| `nebula_execute` | R"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"un one GQL statement on a connection. Arguments: `connectionId` (required), `gql` (required), `timeo"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"utMs`. Returns `{ ok, columns, rows, numRows, latencyUs, summary?, error? }`. |
| `nebula_schema` | "},{"id":"p9s9","text":"Introspect a graph's schema. Arguments: `connectionId` (required), `graph` (optional — defaults to t"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"he session working graph, then the sole graph). Runs `SHOW GRAPHS` + `DESC GRAPH TYPE`, returns `{ g"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"raphs, graph, nodes, edges, … }`. Read-only. |
| `nebula_disconnect` | Close a connection and releas"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"e its server-side session. |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Skill"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The plugin registers a `bundled` skill provider on `ctx.skills` named
`dsh-nebula` that serves the *"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"*`gql-query-generator`** skill from the packaged
`gql-query-generator/` directory. The model can loa"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"d it through the `skill`
tool (or a direct user invocation); its `references/*.md` resolve against t"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"he
packaged directory via the skill's `resourceBase`. The skill body is read
from disk on each load,"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" so editing `SKILL.md` takes effect without a rebuild
for link-installed plugins."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Typical agent flow:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The plugin is an out-of-tree DSH bundle: a plain npm package whose manifest
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Protocol** — the vendored protos under `src/proto/nebula/` are the
official NebulaGraph 5.0 defi"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"nitions (graph/common/vector) from
nebula-go v5. `AuthRequest.auth_info` is `JSON.stringify({ passwo"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"rd })` and
`ClientInfo.lang` advertises `JAVASCRIPT`; `Status.code == "00000"` means
success. The pa"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ssword is sent only inside the one-time `Authenticate` call
and cleared from the client/registry opt"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ions immediately after success.
- **Transport security** — the channel uses gRPC credentials per the"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" `tls`
mode: `on` → `createSsl` (with optional CA / client cert / server-name
override), `off` → `cr"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"eateInsecure`, `auto` → try TLS first, then recreate
the channel with plaintext credentials only whe"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"n the handshake fails at the
transport level (never on an authentication failure). A plaintext fallb"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"ack
is surfaced as `tlsFallback` in the connect output and as a warning line.
- **Logout** — the v5 "},{"id":"p17s10","text":"gRPC service has no signout RPC; closing a session
executes the `SESSION CLOSE` statement before rel"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"easing the channel
(mirroring nebula-go v5 `connection.Close()`), so the server-side session
is rele"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"ased immediately instead of lingering until its idle timeout.
- **Decoder** — `src/decode/` is a fai"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"thful TypeScript port of nebula-go v5's
`internal/decode` (column type schemas, flat/const vector la"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"youts, chunked
strings, node/edge property vectors, path adjacency lists, composite value
encoding)."},{"id":"p17s15","text":"
- **Registry** — open connections live in a per-plugin registry; disposing the
plugin closes them a"},{"id":"p17s16","text":"ll.
- **Instance profiles** — the instance list is part of the plugin's own
profile entry: `instance"},{"id":"p17s17","text":"s` / `defaultInstance` / `credentialRefs` are
`.volatile()` fields of the plugin's `Config` schema, "},{"id":"p17s18","text":"which dsh-settings
≥ 0.2.0 projects into an editable form and commits into the running config's
live"},{"id":"p17s19","text":" references — so a settings save never remounts the plugin. Without a
settings provider the fields k"},{"id":"p17s20","text":"eep their schema defaults (an empty section)
and the tools fall back to config exactly as before, wh"},{"id":"p17s21","text":"ile the Web GUI edits
the same entry over the plugin-owned `/dsh-nebula/api` route. Alias
